reuse.why: Routes the new option through the existing shouldWriteMonthBudgetCategory selection helper that all month-wide actions already use.

duplication.why: The hidden rule stays in one place; each action only forwards the flag.

placement.why: The condition change sits in the shared category-selection function in budget/actions.ts, where the exclusion rules already live.

scope.why: Only the helper, the six month-wide actions' signatures and one test are touched.

maintainability.why: A single optional parameter on the shared rule, defaulting to old behaviour, is easy to own; the repeated forwarding is minimal boilerplate.
